name: step3_cspr_m0_post_run_interpretation_v1

same_step_loss_comparison.interpretation: At the same frozen step size, the projected direction passed both objectives while the unconstrained direction increased the frozen safety loss beyond the registered tolerance.

mechanism_strength.interpretation: The projection was numerically consequential for the safety inequality but was a very small correction to the preference direction. The high wrong-prompt cosine is a descriptive warning that much of the preference gradient is response-driven rather than uniquely prompt-bound.

coverage_field_clarification.conclusion: All 504 registered LoRA parameter tensors received a finite, nonzero gradient. The field name is misleading but the registered tensor-coverage gate is satisfied. Frozen M0 code and outputs were not modified post-run.
